# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One Pro, about $160 with code**
- Lists at $199.99, or $160 with code AFSC20 (20% off full-price items, valid through 2026-12-31). The seller's page says it tested the code on 2026-10-22.
- Battery is 40 hours with ANC on, and a 5-minute fast charge gives 8 hours. It has LDAC, multipoint, and a fold-flat design.
- Tom's Guide also names it Best Under $200.
- Downsides: no IP rating, and it isn't meant for workouts. LDAC doesn't work together with multipoint.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro) (affiliate link) [1][5]

**Best value: Soundcore Space One, about $80 with code**
- Lists at $99.99, or $80 with AFSC20. It has the same 40-hour ANC battery, plus LDAC on Android and multipoint.
- SoundGuys measured about 43 hours with ANC on. LDAC only helps if your phone supports it, so it's no benefit on an iPhone.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one) (affiliate link) [1][7]

**Best ANC performance: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS ranks it the best noise-cancelling headphones under $200 it has tested. It says the ANC competes with flagships from Sony and Bose. I don't have a current price for it, so check the retailer listings on the RTINGS page before buying.
- [RTINGS review with Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200) [2]

**Budget alternative: Soundcore Space Q45**
- RTINGS calls it the best budget ANC headphones, at around $100. It has strong noise isolation against engine rumble and street noise, and nearly 28 hours of battery with ANC on.
- [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones) [4]

**Cheapest: JLab JBuds Lux ANC, about $80**
- It has a 44-hour battery and a 10-band EQ, but the weakest ANC of the group. SoundGuys measured only 10 to 20 dB of cancellation, which is enough for a bus or an office but not a flight.
- [Tom's Guide roundup](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html) [5][7]

**One to skip at current prices:** The Sony WH-CH730N is well reviewed but costs $176–178 in the US, which Tom's Guide says is too high for what you get. [6]

**Which to pick:** For a good balance of price, battery, and comfort, get the Space One Pro. For the best ANC, go with the JBL Live 780NC. If you want to spend as little as possible, the Space One at $80 is hard to beat.

Sources: [1] dealectric.com, [2][4] rtings.com, [5][6] tomsguide.com, [7] ratingmobile.com. Prices come from those pages and may change.
